relationships.subject: Panobinostat
relationships.evidence_quote: Intrathecal panobinostat attenuated nociceptive behavior and restored the downregulated spinal GAD65 and GABA expression in CCI rats.

relationships.subject: Panobinostat
relationships.evidence_quote: Panobinostat can potentially suppress HDAC6 activity directly, resulting in analgesic effects.

relationships.subject: HDAC3
relationships.evidence_quote: Chronic constriction injury–induced HDAC3 and HDAC4 upregulation in neuronal nuclei can attenuate H3K9ac expression.

relationships.subject: HDAC4
relationships.evidence_quote: The activation of HDACs represses gad2 by attenuating H3K9ac expression, resulting in GAD65 downregulation

key_findings: Spinal HDAC3, HDAC4 and HDAC6 are upregulated in dorsal horn neurons after CCI while H3K9ac, GAD65 and GABA fall.
Intrathecal panobinostat reduced HDAC activity, alleviated hyperalgesia and restored GAD65 and GABA.
